title: Development Guides - 开发指南文档

requirements: Create 1 file: docs/guides/subsonic-api.md (Subsonic API 使用指南与认证机制，~120-150 lines)
Create 1 file: docs/guides/state-management.md (Riverpod 状态管理模式，~100-130 lines)
Create 1 file: docs/guides/audio-playback.md (音频引擎架构与播放流程，~100-130 lines)
Create 1 file: docs/guides/platform-adaptation.md (Android/macOS 平台适配，~80-100 lines)
subsonic-api.md must explain: token 认证流程, salt 生成, MD5 计算, 请求参数构造
state-management.md must document 4 existing providers: [sharedPreferencesProvider, serverConfigProvider, subsonicClientProvider, audioPlayerServiceProvider]
audio-playback.md must cover 2 services: [AudioPlayerService (168 lines), NavidromeAudioHandler (32 lines, incomplete)]
platform-adaptation.md must cover 2 platforms: [Android (网络权限/前台Service/通知栏), macOS (窗口管理/entitlements/媒体键)]
acceptance: 4 files created: verify by ls docs/guides/*.md | wc -l = 4
subsonic-api.md explains auth flow: verify by grep -c 'salt\|md5\|token' docs/guides/subsonic-api.md >= 3
state-management.md documents 4 providers: verify by grep -c 'Provider' docs/guides/state-management.md >= 4
audio-playback.md covers 2 services: verify by grep -c 'AudioPlayerService\|AudioHandler' docs/guides/audio-playback.md >= 2
platform-adaptation.md covers 2 platforms: verify by grep -c 'Android\|macOS' docs/guides/platform-adaptation.md >= 4

conventions: Code examples from actual source files
Chinese content with English code snippets
